model_output:
To calculate the PI number using Go, you can use the `math/math.h` package, which provides mathematical functions for various Go standard libraries. Here's an example code snippet to calculate PI using Go:

```go
package main

import (
    "fmt"
    "math/math.h"
)

func main() {
    pi := math.Pi
    fmt.Println(pi)
}
```

In this code snippet, we import the `math/math.h` package and use it to define the value of PI. We then print the value of PI using the `fmt.Println` function.
When you run this code, it will output the value of PI to the console.
